canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before data fetch; fingerprint recorded once the 12-ETF universe is present on the executing machine, per protocol Implementation and artifact contract step 3

sma.definition: State_SMA(t) = 1{SMA_fast(t) > SMA_slow(t)}, both computed on adjusted daily closes through completed close t

volatility.estimator: trailing 20-session close-to-close log-return standard deviation, annualized by sqrt(252)
volatility.reference: expanding median of the trailing-vol series from the first post-warm-up session through t
volatility.note: self-referential; no external target_vol or leverage/weight-cap contract required

states.warm_up_rationale: long enough for a stable 50-session SMA and a non-degenerate expanding median; short enough to keep 2008 inside the evaluated sample for every asset including DBC's 2006 inception

gated_return.timing_note: state computed through completed close t-1 gates day t's return, matching ADR 0001 signal/fill separation even though no position is opened in this no-trade experiment

bootstrap.extension_required: state-recomputing variant: resample raw returns in circular blocks, reconstruct a synthetic price path, recompute both trailing states on the resampled path, then compute delta_sigma/delta_mdd on the resampled state-recomputed path
bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled_delta <= observed_delta (favourable is negative), plus add-one correction, mirroring the existing function's convention with the inequality direction flipped

correction.family_definition: 12 assets x 2 statistics (delta_sigma, delta_mdd) per state; SMA state and volatility-placebo state are separate families, each independently Holm-corrected, not pooled

materiality.significance: holm_adjusted_p <= alpha for both statistics on the same asset

gates.placebo_rule: for each asset meeting materiality, the SMA state's delta_sigma and delta_mdd must each be more favourable (more negative) than the volatility-state placebo's delta_sigma/delta_mdd on the same asset
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical delta_sigma/delta_mdd/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.sma_window_grid: none in this run; a neighbourhood robustness check (e.g. 10/30, 50/100) is explicitly deferred to a separate, independently justified amendment if this result is material_and_consistent

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade characterization run; deferred to any later executable-expression protocol
scope_exclusions.no_pooled_panel_estimator: deliberate; avoids the panel/permutation infrastructure gap that parked Cycle 2's cross-sectional-rotation candidate
scope_exclusions.no_book_level_or_leveraged_expression: Candidate B's book-level/continuous-weight expression remains parked pending a portfolio-weighting engine; only the single-asset binary placebo state is in scope here
